import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings
import os
import time

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
np.random.seed(42)

print(f"Starting at {time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}")
print("Loading data...")

train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("input/sample_submission.csv")

os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "target"]]
train_df["target"] = train_df["target"].astype(int)
test_ids = test_df["id"].copy()

# Identify categorical and numeric columns
cat_cols = [col for col in feature_cols if train_df[col].dtype == "object"]
print(f"Categorical columns: {cat_cols}")

# CRITICAL FIX: Apply target encoding BEFORE split to avoid data leakage
# First, compute target encoding statistics from training data only
target_encode_mean = train_df.groupby("f_27")["target"].mean()
overall_mean = train_df["target"].mean()

# Apply encoding to all datasets
train_df["f_27"] = train_df["f_27"].map(target_encode_mean).fillna(overall_mean)
test_df["f_27"] = test_df["f_27"].map(target_encode_mean).fillna(overall_mean)

# Convert f_27 to numeric (float) after target encoding - CRITICAL FIX
print("Converting f_27 to numeric after target encoding...")
train_df["f_27"] = train_df["f_27"].astype(float)
test_df["f_27"] = test_df["f_27"].astype(float)

# Remove f_27 from categorical list since it's now numeric
cat_cols = [col for col in cat_cols if col != "f_27"]

# Create polynomial feature for f_28
print("Creating polynomial feature for f_28...")
train_df["f_28_sq"] = train_df["f_28"] ** 2
test_df["f_28_sq"] = test_df["f_28"] ** 2

# Create interaction features with correct feature names
interaction_features = ["f_07", "f_08", "f_19", "f_20"]
print("Creating interaction features...")
for idx, feature in enumerate(interaction_features):
    train_df[f"f_29_x_{feature}"] = train_df["f_29"] * train_df[feature]
    test_df[f"f_29_x_{feature}"] = test_df["f_29"] * test_df[feature]

for idx, feature in enumerate(interaction_features):
    train_df[f"f_30_x_{feature}"] = train_df["f_30"] * train_df[feature]
    test_df[f"f_30_x_{feature}"] = test_df["f_30"] * test_df[feature]

train_df["f_29_x_f_30"] = train_df["f_29"] * train_df["f_30"]
test_df["f_29_x_f_30"] = test_df["f_29"] * test_df["f_30"]

# Update feature columns after all transformations
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "target"]]
print(f"Total features: {len(feature_cols)}")

# Prepare X and y for model
X_train_full = train_df[feature_cols]
X_test_full = test_df[feature_cols]
y_train_full = train_df["target"]

# Split AFTER all feature engineering to ensure consistent splits
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full,
    y_train_full,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_full,
)

print(
    f"Training data: {len(X_train)}, Validation data: {len(X_val)}, Test data: {len(X_test_full)}"
)

# Ensure all dtypes are numeric (LightGBM requirement)
for col in X_train.columns:
    if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(X_train[col]):
        X_train[col] = X_train[col].astype(float)
for col in X_val.columns:
    if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(X_val[col]):
        X_val[col] = X_val[col].astype(float)
for col in X_test_full.columns:
    if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(X_test_full[col]):
        X_test_full[col] = X_test_full[col].astype(float)

lgb_train = lgb.Dataset(X_train, label=y_train)
lgb_val = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=lgb_train)

print("Training model...")
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "reg_alpha": 0.1,
    "reg_lambda": 0.1,
}

callbacks = [
    lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False),
    lgb.log_evaluation(period=0),
]

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    lgb_train,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[lgb_train, lgb_val],
    valid_names=["train", "valid"],
    callbacks=callbacks,
)

# Evaluate on hold-out validation set
val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
test_preds = model.predict(X_test_full)

# Create submission file matching sample format
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_preds})
submission_df.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to submission/submission.csv with {len(submission_df)} rows")

print(f"Completed at {time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}")
